steps.data:
<?php
// Brine product importer. Reads /wp-content/uploads/brine-products.csv and creates simple products.
$csv_path = '/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/brine-products.csv';
if ( ! file_exists( $csv_path ) ) {
    if ( class_exists( 'WP_CLI' ) ) { WP_CLI::warning( 'Brine CSV missing: ' . $csv_path ); }
    return;
}
if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) ) {
    if ( class_exists( 'WP_CLI' ) ) { WP_CLI::error( 'WooCommerce is not loaded.' ); }
    return;
}
$handle = fopen( $csv_path, 'r' );
if ( ! $handle ) { return; }
$header = fgetcsv( $handle );
if ( ! $header ) { fclose( $handle ); return; }
$created = 0;
$skipped = 0;
while ( ( $row = fgetcsv( $handle ) ) !== false ) {
    if ( count( $row ) < count( $header ) ) {
        $row = array_pad( $row, count( $header ), '' );
    }
    $data = array_combine( $header, $row );
    if ( empty( $data['Name'] ) || empty( $data['SKU'] ) ) { continue; }
    if ( wc_get_product_id_by_sku( $data['SKU'] ) ) { $skipped++; continue; }
    $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $product->set_name( $data['Name'] );
    $product->set_sku( $data['SKU'] );
    if ( ! empty( $data['Regular price'] ) ) {
        $product->set_regular_price( $data['Regular price'] );
    }
    if ( isset( $data['Description'] ) ) {
        $product->set_description( $data['Description'] );
    }
    if ( isset( $data['Short description'] ) ) {
        $product->set_short_description( $data['Short description'] );
    }
    $product->set_status( ( isset( $data['Published'] ) && (string) $data['Published'] === '1' ) ? 'publish' : 'draft' );
    $product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
    $product->set_manage_stock( false );
    $product->set_stock_status( 'instock' );
    if ( ! empty( $data['Categories'] ) ) {
        $cat_ids = array();
        $paths = array_map( 'trim', explode( ',', $data['Categories'] ) );
        foreach ( $paths as $path ) {
            if ( $path === '' ) { continue; }
            $segments = array_map( 'trim', explode( '>', $path ) );
            $parent_id = 0;
            $term_id = 0;
            foreach ( $segments as $segment ) {
                if ( $segment === '' ) { continue; }
                $existing = term_exists( $segment, 'product_cat', $parent_id );
                if ( $existing ) {
                    $term_id = is_array( $existing ) ? (int) $existing['term_id'] : (int) $existing;
                } else {
                    $new = wp_insert_term( $segment, 'product_cat', array( 'parent' => $parent_id ) );
                    if ( is_wp_error( $new ) ) { $term_id = 0; break; }
                    $term_id = (int) $new['term_id'];
                }
                $parent_id = $term_id;
            }
            if ( $term_id ) { $cat_ids[] = $term_id; }
        }
        if ( ! empty( $cat_ids ) ) {
            $product->set_category_ids( array_values( array_unique( $cat_ids ) ) );
        }
    }
    $product->save();
    $created++;
}
fclose( $handle );
if ( class_exists( 'WP_CLI' ) ) { WP_CLI::success( sprintf( 'Imported %d Brine products (%d skipped).', $created, $skipped ) ); }
